name: Aave Savings GHO
oneLiner: sGHO is Aave's savings wrapper of GHO; deposit GHO to earn the Aave governance-set savings rate in GHO, with GHO-tier CDP risk underneath.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: sGHO resolves to Upstream because deposits remain GHO and inherit Aave-governance-controlled GHO admin authorities.

mintAuthority.summary: sGHO is a savings wrapper over GHO; wrapper minting is share accounting while durable GHO mint authority is inherited from reviewed Aave facilitator controls.

controls.label: sGHO savings wrapper
controls.evidence: Local metadata marks sGHO as `variantOf: gho-aave` and `variantKind: savings-passthrough`; parent GHO has reviewed facilitator-bucket mintAuthority.

review.evidence: sGHO should inherit GHO's reviewed facilitator-bucket mint authority; wrapper-specific minting is savings/share accounting.
unresolvedQuestions: ERC-4626 `asset()` reverted on the sGHO contract through public Ethereum RPC; keep confidence at manual-review unless a protocol-specific asset getter is verified.

collateral: GHO deposited into Aave's current sGHO / legacy stkGHO-compatible savings contract; reward emissions accrue to depositors in GHO at the Aave-governance-set savings rate
pegMechanism: Deposit GHO into the ERC-4626 sGHO vault to mint sGHO shares; the share-to-GHO exchange rate rises as the Aave-governance-set savings rate accrues. The vault's `asset()` is GHO and standard ERC-4626 `convertToAssets()` / `totalAssets()` reads expose NAV per share. Pharos prices this entry from the vault's share exchange rate rather than secondary-market liquidity.

notices.title: Legacy savings contract
notices.message: The tracked Aave sGHO contract currently resolves as stkGHO-compatible rather than a full ERC-4626 vault. Pharos uses `previewRedeem` for price discovery and live reserve telemetry, and avoids the generic ERC-4626 reserve adapter until the replacement savings vault exposes standard asset and totalAssets methods.
